hero.title: Duty Calculator
hero.subtitle: Search HTS codes and calculate estimated duties and landed cost for your shipment.

calc.title: Calculator
calc.productInfo: Type an HTS code (e.g. 4202.92) or a product keyword. Results come from our HTS database and from past answers by our customs team.
calc.productPlaceholder: Enter HTS code or product description
calc.valueInfo: Customs (transaction) value of the goods in US dollars. Duties and fees are calculated on this amount.
calc.datesHint: Dates are saved with the calculation for reference; they do not change the estimate.

search.label: HTS suggestions
search.minChars: Type at least 2 characters to search
search.noResultsHint: Try a shorter code or another keyword, or ask our customs team.
search.noAnswer: This inquiry has no HTS answer yet.
search.codeNotFound: HTS {{code}} is not in the database — showing closest matches.

additional.title: Additional duties from HTS data
additional.hint: Apply only to certain origins or products — never added automatically. Select those that apply.

exclusion.title: Potential Exclusion Codes
exclusion.info: Record exclusion codes (e.g. Chapter 99 numbers) you intend to claim. They are listed in the results for reference; their effect on duties is not computed.
exclusion.notComputed: Exclusions are not deducted from the estimate — confirm eligibility with our customs team.
exclusion.toggleHint: Click a code to mark it Applied / Not Applied.

validation.item: Select an HTS code from the suggestions
validation.value: Enter a valid shipment value (or leave it empty)

toast.saveNeedsInput: Select an HTS code before saving
toast.askSent: Inquiry sent — our customs team will reply in My Inquiries

ask.title: Ask our customs team
ask.intro: Describe your product and a licensed broker will classify it. The answer appears under My Inquiries → HTS Inquiries.
ask.descriptionPlaceholder: What is it, what is it made of, how is it used?

results.title: Results
results.updatedInfo: Date the HTS rate data for this code was last updated.
results.dutyRateInfo: Base rate plus the additional duties you selected, as a percentage of shipment value.
results.emptyBody: Search an HTS code to see the duty rate. Add a shipment value to estimate amounts.
results.emptyReady: Ready — click Calculate Duties to see the estimate.

detail.title: Detailed Breakdown
detail.hmfDesc: U.S. HMF ({{rate}} of value, ocean only)

warnings.nonAdValorem: The base rate “{{rate}}” is a specific or compound rate (per unit/weight). It can't be calculated from value alone, so totals are not shown — ask our customs team for an exact figure.
warnings.additionalAvailable: {{count}} additional duty programme(s) available for this code are not included. Select them on the left if they apply.

disclaimer: Estimated rates. Final customs assessment may vary.
